roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/sign-in/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Sign-in / sign-up page example: centred Card with Field-wrapped email and password, one primary submit, optional 'or' Divider and SSO buttons. Presentational: the app passes callbacks.

mode.note: sign-up adds a Name field, drops Remember me and Forgot password, and swaps the copy.

providers.note: { id, label, icon? } — secondary block Buttons under Divider label="or". icon is any Lucide name or a Lucide component (same as Button iconStart). Omit for email only.

onSubmit.note: (values: { email, password, name?, remember? }) => void. Called only after required and email-format checks pass.

onForgotPassword.note: Shows 'Forgot password?' (tertiary sm) in sign-in mode.

onSwitchMode.note: (next: mode) => void. Shows the footer switch link.

error.note: Server failure. Danger Alert above the form.

loading.note: Primary disabled with a busy label; SSO disabled; form aria-busy.

requirements: Tab order: (name) → email → password → remember → forgot → primary → SSO → switch link
Enter in any input submits (form with a type=submit primary)
Validation errors go through Field error; focus moves to the first invalid input
The form is noValidate so browser bubbles never replace Field errors

must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one variant="primary" Button per view (submit); SSO buttons are secondary, forgot and switch are tertiary
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Wrap every labeled input in Field (label, hint, and error wiring)

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
Submit is a type=submit Button inside the form (Enter submits), not a Card footer action
defaults: A full page on surface.page with no app chrome (no AppHeader or SideNav); put it in your own layout if you prefer
Presentational: pass callbacks (onSubmit, onProvider, …); wire your own auth, never store credentials in the component
Centred Card with Field-wrapped email and password, optional Divider label="or" and SSO buttons
snippet: <SignInPattern productName="Agentix" providers={[{ id: "google", label: "Continue with Google" }]} onSubmit={(values) => signIn(values)} onProvider={(id) => sso(id)} onForgotPassword={() => {}} onSwitchMode={setMode} />
